Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ صَبْرَ الشَّاكِرِينَ لَكَ
Translation: O Allah, I ask You for the patience of those who are grateful to You
And the deeds of those who fear You
And the certainty of those who worship You
O Allah, You are the Most High, the Most Great
And I am Your servant, wretched and poor
You are the Self-Sufficient, the Praiseworthy
And I am the humble servant

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family
And bestow Your wealth upon my poverty
And Your forbearance upon my ignorance
And Your strength upon my weakness

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family
The successors, the ones with whom You are pleased

Arabic text: وَاكْفِنِيْ مَا أَهَمَّنِيْ مِنْ أَمْرِ الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ
Translation: And suffice me in what concerns me from the affairs of this world and the hereafter
O Most Merciful of those who show mercy
